messages:
Mira (Partnerships): Quick sync — LangChain asked for a combined marketplace + SI onboarding bundle for gateway adapters. Need a concise checklist and minimal artifacts to hand to partners. :wave:

Tom (Eng Integrations): Minimal artifacts: quickstart repo, CI smoke tests, marketplace manifest, adapter compatibility table, infra SKUs, and a small observability snippet.

Isha (DevEx): I can scaffold the quickstart + GH Action to run smoke tests. Will include a deterministic dataset and reproducible prompts.

Luca (Product): We should define a "Verified" badge policy: pass harness + provide marketplace assets. Drafting thresholds (example: 95th pct latency < 300ms on small model + embedding similarity > 0.98).

Mira (Partnerships): Preflight smoke tests (CI runnable with one env var): API key + OIDC auth handshake, sync generate, streaming smoke, embedding vector check, and fallback to smaller model scenario.

Tom (Eng Integrations): I'll build a small test harness and an error-injection test to simulate OOM/latency and validate fallback routing to a smaller model.

Isha (DevEx): I'll add terraform + helm snippets for a minimal Dedicated stack and an air-gapped install note. Also a GH Action that posts status to PR.

Luca (Product): Add a billing/metering mapping doc explaining gateway vs orchestrator metering and recommended approaches for partner demos.

DevEx-bot: Created PART-5209 assigned to Isha and Tom

Mira (Partnerships): Assignments: Isha = repo + CI; Tom = test harness + infra reqs; Luca = badge policy + billing mapping; Mira = partner comms & scheduling. Target: draft bundle by next Tue; partner tech review next Wed. Drop pre-reads under /docs/onboarding by EOD Tue.

Tom (Eng Integrations): I'll list recommended GPU SKUs (T4/A10x/H100 where applicable), memory baselines per model family, and quantization guidance (8-bit/4-bit notes).

Mira (Partnerships): Also require partners to provide a sample dataset and deterministic prompts for verification. I'll schedule a 30-min dry run with LangChain + one reference SI next week. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
